name: tbill_3m
description: 3-month T-bill secondary-market rate, discount basis, % p.a.; last trading day of month.

name: ust_zero_01y
description: 1-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: ust_zero_02y
description: 2-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: ust_zero_03y
description: 3-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: ust_zero_05y
description: 5-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: ust_zero_07y
description: 7-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: ust_zero_10y
description: 10-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: ust_zero_20y
description: 20-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: ust_zero_30y
description: 30-year zero-coupon Treasury yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright fitted curve, continuously compounded, %); last business day of month. Each day's curve is fitted to that day's prices only.

name: term_spread_10y_3m
description: 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield minus 3-month T-bill rate, percentage points, month end.

name: acm_tp_02y
description: Adrian-Crump-Moench 2-year Treasury term premium, %, month end. [HINDSIGHT] Affine model whose parameters are estimated over the full sample and re-estimated as data arrive, so past values are revised and embed later information.

name: acm_tp_05y
description: Adrian-Crump-Moench 5-year Treasury term premium, %, month end. [HINDSIGHT] Affine model whose parameters are estimated over the full sample and re-estimated as data arrive, so past values are revised and embed later information.

name: acm_tp_10y
description: Adrian-Crump-Moench 10-year Treasury term premium, %, month end. [HINDSIGHT] Affine model whose parameters are estimated over the full sample and re-estimated as data arrive, so past values are revised and embed later information.

name: kw_tp_10y
description: Kim-Wright 10-year Treasury term premium, %, month end. [HINDSIGHT] Three-factor affine model estimated over the full sample with survey data; history is revised.

name: tips_real_05y
description: 5-year zero-coupon TIPS real yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright, %), month end. Starts 1999.

name: tips_real_10y
description: 10-year zero-coupon TIPS real yield (Gurkaynak-Sack-Wright, %), month end. Starts 1999.

name: breakeven_05y
description: 5-year zero-coupon breakeven inflation (GSW nominal minus TIPS curve, %), month end.

name: breakeven_10y
description: 10-year zero-coupon breakeven inflation (GSW nominal minus TIPS curve, %), month end.

name: breakeven_5y5y
description: 5-year breakeven inflation 5 years forward (GSW, %), month end.

name: aaa_yield
description: Moody's seasoned Aaa corporate bond yield, %; MONTHLY AVERAGE of daily yields (known at month end, staler than a month-end print).

name: baa_yield
description: Moody's seasoned Baa corporate bond yield, %; monthly average of daily yields.

name: baa_aaa_spread
description: Default spread: Moody's Baa minus Aaa yield, pp; monthly averages.

name: baa_ust10_spread
description: Moody's Baa yield minus 10-year constant-maturity Treasury, pp; both monthly averages.

name: gz_spread
description: Gilchrist-Zakrajsek corporate credit spread (average spread of senior unsecured bonds of US non-financial firms over matched synthetic Treasuries, pp), all rating grades. Lagged 1 month for publication. Not model-estimated.

name: us_div_yield
source: Shiller ie_data D; S&P 500 month-end close (Goyal-Welch, FRED SP500)
description: S&P 500 trailing 12-month dividends / month-end index level. Dividends (Shiller, interpolated from quarterly totals) are lagged 4 months; price is not lagged. lag_months refers to the dividend input.

name: us_earn_yield
source: Shiller ie_data E; S&P 500 month-end close
description: S&P 500 trailing 12-month reported earnings / month-end index level. Earnings are lagged 6 months (quarterly reports arrive with a lag and Shiller interpolates within the quarter); price is not lagged.

name: us_cape
source: Shiller ie_data E; FRED CPIAUCNS; S&P 500 month-end close
description: Cyclically adjusted P/E: real month-end S&P 500 (deflated by CPI known at t) / 10-year average real earnings ending 6 months before t. Recomputed here rather than taken from Shiller's column, which uses unlagged earnings and an average price.

name: us_bm_djia
description: Dow Jones Industrials book-to-market (Goyal-Welch): prior-year-end book (two years back in Jan-Feb) over month-end price; shifted a further month. Ends with the Goyal-Welch update (2025-12).

name: devx_div_yield
source: Ken French international indices (Ind_all, with and without dividends)
description: Developed ex-US (EAFE + Canada) trailing 12-month dividend yield: sum over 12 months of USD total return minus price return of French's value-weighted international index. French updates the file annually, so the series ends at the last update (2025-12).

name: devx_bm
description: Developed ex-US market book-to-market: French's December B/M (book for fiscal year y-1), used from June of year y (6-month accounting lag), rolled forward monthly with the price-only index. Ends 2025-12.

name: gold_real
description: Real gold price: monthly-average USD gold price / CPI-U NSA known at t (prior month's index) x 100. Gold is datahub's monthly series (an average over the month, not a month-end fix).

name: wti_roll_yield
source: EIA Cushing WTI futures contracts 1 and 2 (RCLC1, RCLC2)
description: WTI crude futures roll yield, annualised: 12 x ln(F1/F2) on the last common trading day of the month. Positive = backwardation. EIA stopped publishing the contract series in April 2024.

name: cpi_yoy
description: CPI-U all items, not seasonally adjusted, 12-month log change, placed at the month it was first published (ALFRED release dates from 1949; at least 1 month after the reference month). The NSA index is not revised after release, so this is effectively real-time.

name: core_cpi_yoy
description: CPI-U less food and energy, NSA, 12-month log change; placed at the headline CPI release month (same release), at least 1 month after the reference month. NSA index is not revised.

name: infl_exp_1y_mich
description: University of Michigan median expected inflation over the next year, %. Final reading is released late in the survey month; lagged 1 month to be safe.

name: ip_yoy_rt
description: Industrial production, 12-month log change of the latest month in the vintage in force at t (release ~mid m+1, so normally reference month t-1).

name: payrolls_yoy_rt
description: Nonfarm payrolls, 12-month log change of the latest month in the vintage in force at t (first Friday of m+1 release).

name: payrolls_3m_rt
description: Nonfarm payrolls, 3-month log change (not annualised) of the latest month, within the vintage in force at t.

name: unemployment_rt
description: Civilian unemployment rate, %, latest month in the vintage in force at t.

name: avg_hours_mfg_rt
description: Average weekly hours of production workers, manufacturing; latest value in the vintage in force at t.

name: housing_starts_rt
description: Housing starts, thousands SAAR; latest value in the vintage in force at t.

name: building_permits
description: New private housing permits, thousands SAAR; revised data lagged 1 month, and from Sep 1999 placed at the actual first-release month from ALFRED (catches shutdown delays).

name: retail_sales_yoy_rt
description: Retail sales, 12-month log change within the vintage in force at t; the discontinued SIC-based RETAIL series until its last vintage, the NAICS-based RSAFS after.

name: capacity_util
description: Total industry capacity utilisation, %; revised data lagged 1 month, and from Dec 1996 placed at the first-release month from ALFRED.

name: cfnai
description: Chicago Fed National Activity Index; released ~4 weeks after the month, lagged 1 month (first-release month from ALFRED from mid-2011). [HINDSIGHT] First principal component of 85 indicators with weights estimated on the full revised sample.

name: jobless_claims_4wk
description: Initial jobless claims, 4-week average of the last four weeks published by month end (week ending Saturday, published the following Thursday). Seasonal factors are revised; lag applied in days, so lag_months is 0.

name: m2_yoy_rt
description: M2 money stock, 12-month log change within the vintage in force at t (vintages from 1980).

name: bank_ci_loans_yoy
description: Commercial and industrial loans at commercial banks, 12-month log change; revised data lagged 1 month (first-release month from ALFRED from Dec 1996). Contains reclassification breaks (e.g. 2010).

name: consumer_credit_yoy
description: Total consumer credit outstanding, 12-month log change; G.19 is released ~5 weeks after the month, so lagged 2 months (first-release month from ALFRED from Dec 1996 when later).

name: fed_funds
description: Effective federal funds rate, monthly average of daily rates, %. (The final day's rate is published the next morning; immaterial for a monthly average.)

name: nfci
description: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index, latest weekly reading published by month end (Friday reading, published the next Wednesday). [HINDSIGHT] Dynamic factor model re-estimated each week over the full sample; the whole history is revised.

name: anfci
description: Adjusted NFCI (purged of the business cycle and inflation), latest weekly reading published by month end. [HINDSIGHT] Full-sample factor model plus full-sample regression on macro conditions.

name: stl_fsi
description: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index (v4), latest weekly reading published by month end. [HINDSIGHT] Principal component of 18 standardised series, re-estimated on the full sample.

name: kc_fsi
description: Kansas City Fed Financial Stress Index, monthly; lagged 1 month. [HINDSIGHT] Principal component with full-sample loadings.

name: usd_major
description: Nominal trade-weighted US dollar against major currencies, month end. The Fed's discontinued major-currency index until Jan 2006, then chained to its successor, the advanced foreign economies index, at that month (the link uses only data known then).

name: wti_spot
description: WTI crude spot price, USD/bbl, monthly average (known at month end; staler than a month-end print).

name: vix
description: CBOE VIX, close on the last trading day of the month. Starts 1990.

name: vxo
description: CBOE S&P 100 volatility index (old VIX methodology), month-end close, 1986 to its 2021 discontinuation.

name: vrp
description: Variance risk premium proxy: VIX^2/12 (implied monthly variance) minus realised variance of daily S&P 500 returns in the same month (Goyal-Welch svar), x 1e4 (monthly %^2). Both known at month end. Ends with the Goyal-Welch update (2025-12).

name: equity_put_call
description: CBOE equity-option put/call volume ratio, monthly average of daily ratios. Free history covers only Oct 2003 - Oct 2019; definition changed in 2012 (ETF options removed).

name: umich_sentiment
description: University of Michigan consumer sentiment index; lagged 1 month. Quarterly before 1978 (latest reading carried for up to two months).

name: bw_sentiment
description: Baker-Wurgler investor sentiment index, orthogonalised to macro conditions; lagged 1 month; ends 2018-12. [HINDSIGHT] First principal component of the components, estimated over the full sample, after full-sample regressions on macro variables.

name: bw_closed_end_discount
description: Value-weighted closed-end fund discount, % (Baker-Wurgler component, raw); lagged 1 month; ends 2018-12.

name: bw_ipo_count
description: Number of IPOs in the month (Baker-Wurgler component, raw); lagged 1 month; ends 2018-12.

name: bw_ipo_first_day_ret
description: Average first-day IPO return, % (Baker-Wurgler component, raw); lagged 1 month; ends 2018-12.

name: bw_equity_share
description: Equity share of new equity and debt issues (Baker-Wurgler component, raw); lagged 1 month; ends 2018-12.

name: bw_div_premium
description: Dividend premium: log difference of average market-to-book of payers and non-payers (Baker-Wurgler component, raw, annual accounting data); lagged 1 month; ends 2018-12.

name: net_equity_issuance
description: Net equity expansion: 12-month moving sum of net issues by NYSE stocks / total end-of-year market cap (Goyal-Welch, from CRSP); lagged 1 month; ends 2025-12.

name: margin_debt
description: Debit balances in customers' securities margin accounts, USD millions (FINRA, from 1997); released the following month, lagged 1 month.

name: excess_bond_premium
description: Gilchrist-Zakrajsek excess bond premium, pp; lagged 1 month. [HINDSIGHT] Residual of a full-sample regression of bond spreads on firm default risk; the history is re-estimated with each update.

name: epu_news
description: Baker-Bloom-Davis news-based economic policy uncertainty index (historical newspaper index before 1985); lagged 1 month. Scaled to mean 100 over a fixed base period (a constant rescaling).

name: gpr
description: Geopolitical risk index (10 newspapers, from 1985); lagged 1 month. Scaled to mean 100 over 1985-2019 (a constant rescaling).

name: gpr_hist
description: Historical geopolitical risk index (3 newspapers, from 1900); lagged 1 month.
